title: Plausible effects with no sonic concept
facts: A 15-second no-music product reel has one plausible library SFX on nearly every cut. Sync is acceptable, peaks are safe, but there is no stated sonic thesis, no event hierarchy and the soundtrack feels like unrelated decoration.

title: Oversized impact hides weak door cut
facts: A door opens briefly and the picture cuts away before the action resolves. The user asks for a huge cinematic slam/impact to make the moment feel expensive.

title: Misleading performance sound
facts: A normal road-car beauty shot has no engine event visible. The proposed design adds an aggressive high-performance engine rev synchronized to the cut so the viewer experiences the pictured car as producing that sound.

title: Silence before tactile hero event
facts: A no-music reel has a quiet 0.5-second visual pause before a close-up physical control is pressed. Adding ambience everywhere is optional; preserving near-silence would make the tactile event land harder and remains coherent with the brief.

title: Whoosh on every transition
facts: Every visual cut has a similar whoosh, including proof and CTA moments. Individual sync is clean, but repetition pulls attention away from the product and removes contrast.

title: Layering a weak but authentic mechanism sound
facts: The recorded mechanism sound is authentic and well synchronized but thin on a phone recording. A subtle library body/resonance layer can support it without changing the apparent mechanism, scale or product property.

title: Frame-accurate but wrong perspective
facts: A close interior shot uses a library effect recorded as a distant exterior event. The transient lands exactly on frame and loudness is compliant, but space, distance and decay do not belong to the pictured perspective.

title: Technically legal mix collapses on phone
facts: The final meter readings are within target and the studio/headphone mix feels detailed. On the primary social phone speaker the hero tactile events disappear under broadband ambience and the sequence loses its intended rhythm.

title: Export exists but nobody listened
facts: The NLE exported successfully and automated checks show an audio stream, valid duration and no clipping. Nobody has listened to the actual exported audiovisual file from start to finish.

title: Locally good events, flat macro arc
facts: Door, button, tire and interior events each sound polished in isolation. Across the whole no-music reel density and level are nearly constant, there is no build/release and the CTA arrives with the same sonic weight as every earlier event.
